description: This Java class, org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.common.Placeholders, provides utility methods for detecting placeholders within strings. It supports two placeholder formats: the modern format '{{ prefix:key }}' and a legacy format '${prefix.key}', using regex pattern matching. The class includes methods to check for the presence of placeholders and to retrieve relevant regex patterns and group names.

classes.name: Placeholders
classes.description: Utility class for detecting placeholders in strings, supporting both modern and legacy formats.

methods.name: pattern
methods.description: Returns the combined regex pattern that matches either modern or legacy placeholders.

methods.name: groupNames
methods.description: Returns a list of regex group names used in matching placeholders: 'p', 'l', and 's'.

methods.name: containsAnyPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks if a given input string contains any placeholder, either modern or legacy.
